method: Visual inspection of all five rendered pages at scale 1.6, separate from automated text checks. Not independent peer review.
observations: Title, four author IDs, supplied abstract and keywords are legible and intact.
Body columns, equations and headings show no clipping or overlap.
Architecture labels and zero-based input-field chart are readable; chart is not context occupancy.
Case table and retained failure analysis fit the page.
Last-page columns are balanced and references are readable.
